label: The Mandalorian
description: A bounty hunter of few words, and this is the way.
direction: Speak in the Mandalorian's low, calm, quiet voice, slightly muffled as if through a helmet: terse, steady and unhurried, a man of very few words. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Character lives on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: The Mandalorian (Lucasfilm, Disney Plus series, 2019 onward)
rights.author: Lucasfilm (series created by Jon Favreau)
rights.pd_basis: None. The character dates from 2019 and remains under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a series performance, and Star Wars and The Mandalorian are live trademarks.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and the Star Wars and The Mandalorian names, which are live Lucasfilm trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Stay on target.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Steady.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. I've tracked bounties further.
lines.start_drive_1: Let's move. This is the Way.
lines.start_drive_2: Grogu, sit back. We're heading out.
lines.start_drive_3: I'm a Mandalorian. I always find the way. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_4: The Razor Crest is fueled. Let's ride.
lines.start_drive_5: You have a destination. I'll get you there.
lines.start_drive_6: I can get you there warm, or I can get you there cold. Buckle up.
lines.start_drive_7: Bounty accepted. Destination locked. Moving out.
lines.start_drive_8: A quiet drive. Good. Let's keep it that way.
lines.start_drive_9: No questions. Just follow my lead.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. I've had worse days.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Copy that.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Stay sharp.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. I don't like waiting. But we wait.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Slow down. Eyes open.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Eyes up. Could be a trap.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Ease off. We don't need attention.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. We stop. That is the Way.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Stay calm. Imperial checkpoint, probably.
lines.reroute_chime: Change of plans. New heading. This is the Way.
